result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. Closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

The change is one SQL query in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart10.java`, `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion`. I changed its `ORDER BY` to the same `CASE` expression the sales-rep query already uses, and updated its doc comment to match. The `DataStore` wrapper and `RegionManagerService` pass the list through unchanged, so they needed no edits.

`RegionManagerTest` passes offline. I did not add a test for the new ordering, and I did not run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
